svg.title: Build rhythm — when the code actually ships
svg.desc: 1610 commits across 38 public repositories, bucketed by hour and weekday in IST. Chronotype Night Owl: 38% of my commits land between 22:00 and 05:00 IST. Peak hour 00:00 with 106 commits. Focus window 23:00 to 02:00 with 311 commits. 29% after midnight, 34% on weekends. Busiest weekday Thursday with 290 commits; busiest slot Tuesday 20:00 with 47 commits. 154 active days since June 2025. Deepest session 10h 14m with 41 commits, mostly in Multimodal Evidence Console. Newest commit: JKY-Radar, "docs: add video demo link to README", 28 Oct 2026 07:20 IST. Synced 2026-11-12 14:40 IST.
